description: Defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, Semaphores, and Event classes for thread synchronization within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion lock, supporting POSIX and Windows platforms.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A binary semaphore class for thread synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A counting semaphore class for managing access to a resource with a maximum count.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A class representing an event object for thread signaling, supporting manual and auto-reset modes.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class for RAII-style locking of synchronization objects.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Sets the event to signaled state.

methods.name: ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.
